stem: The Business Care sales lead asks: "Of the leads that marketing qualified from our June webinars, what share did sales then accept as sales-qualified?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: Sales and marketing cost / new customers won from the webinars
Webinar spend / leads the webinars brought in
100 × MQLs that became sales-qualified / all the June webinar MQLs
100 × customers lost in the month / customers at the start of the month
